print_errors.note: Checked at 2400 dpi. The shadda and its fatha sit over the ع, and the ر has no mark. The expected vowelling is «وَعَرَّفَهُ», with the shadda on the ر. Kept as printed: و+fatha, ع+shadda+fatha, ر bare, ف+fatha, ه+damma.
Printed with final heh (no dots), confirmed at 500 dpi. p021 prints «ممضاة» with ta marbuta. Kept as printed.
Printed «نهني» with no hamza. The standard spelling is «نهنئ». Kept as printed.
Printed with final heh (no dots), confirmed at 800 dpi. The standard spelling is «المنتقاة». Kept as printed.
Printed with a bare initial alif (no hamza), confirmed at 900 dpi. The standard spelling is «إتحاف». Kept as printed.

notes: p024 ends mid-sentence («…مع أنه كان ضنينًا جدًا») and has no footnotes, so p025 is '+' with no (تابع) block. p025 ends «لا يتأتيان إلا» and p026 continues it, so p026 is '+'. p027 and p028 begin new list items after complete items, so they have no '+'. None of the four pages has footnotes, headings, Quran or poetry. Book lists (pp.026-028): each printed line is its own paragraph. One exception on p026: «وترجم إلى اللغة الأردية» is joined to the preceding «إقامة البرهان … (طبع مرتين)» item. That item's line fills the full width of the list block, the next line has no extra indent, and the words describe the same book, so it is a wrap of that item. On p027, «سمير الصالحين ج١ (طبع مرتين) سمير الصالحين ج٢ (طبع)» is printed on one line and kept as one paragraph. «ج١»/«ج٢» are written with no space: the measured gap between ج and the digit is smaller than the word spaces on that line. The second «سمير الصالحين» is set very tight (ر and ال nearly touching) but is written with a normal space. On p028, ﷺ after «النبي» is kept as the glyph, with one space before it. Prose dashes on p025 are ' – ' (en dash with spaces), as in the earlier keyB batches. The only explicit harakat are the tanween (مضافًا، وكيلًا، أيضًا ×3، دويًا، كبيرًا ×2، شيخًا، ردًا، كتابًا، شيئًا، حديثًا ×2) and «وَعَّرفَهُ» on p026. Final ى with the font's automatic small alif is written as plain ى (على، إلى، عيسى، نادى، رأى، سوى، أخرى). «عليه السلام» / «عليهم السلام» are printed as ordinary words. «الإلهية» on p028 has no dagger alif (checked at 1400 dpi). «ومن تعليقات» on p028 is printed without a final ي (one might expect «تعليقاتي»). It is grammatical as it stands, so it is not listed as an error. Digits ٣٣ (p026) are Arabic-Indic as printed.
